card.name: Start of "Interactions" in section 7.1 heading
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "Interactions" ("Inter") in the heading "7.1 Drugs Having Clinically Important Interactions with [drug]". It fires in drug-label drug interaction sections.

modes.label: Section 7.1 heading
modes.description: The "Inter" piece of "Interactions" after "Clinically Important" in the 7.1 heading, before "with" and a drug name.
modes.example: 7.1 Drugs Having Clinically Important<< Inter>>actions with Desvenlafaxine

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated, so there is no clear effect beyond finishing the word.
card.plain: It fires on the start of the word "Interactions" in the standard heading for clinically important drug interactions.
